note: THE THREE LISTS (the user 4 Nov, off the all-planes sheet: "you can keep planes for internal testing too, so we have an exhaustive list"): every aeroplane we have, nothing deleted. official / candidates / internal; n = the sheet's number (39, 40: added since). The garage's All planes screen reads this file (internal: dev only); AIRCRAFT-LOOKS draws its sheet from the copy in evidence-2026-10-18/2026-11-04/all-planes/lists.json. A row's door: file (a repo path; over: sections laid over it, the Client Cub as the career hands it over: storyClientSpec is career core, the sandbox does not load it, and the gate holds the two equal), stock (a stock design), gen (the template's own). rides: the ready branch that brings the file. The Market and the contracts keep their own table (CONTRACT_DESIGNS): a row here touches neither. Official only means shown on this list (the user 4 Nov): an official plane does not become a reference plane for the test battery. GATE PLANELISTS holds this file.
